items.title: End-to-End Agentic AI Framework for Cross-Dataset Medical Image Classification Using CNNs, Vision Transformers, Explainable AI, Robustness Analysis, and LLM-Driven Clinical Reporting
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Medical image classification requires more than high predictive accuracy. A practically useful artificial intelligence system must also provide reliable confidence estimates, robust-ness under image perturbations, interpretable predictions, and meaningful reporting for downstream decision support. This project presents an end-to-end comparative medical imaging framework that evaluates Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformers across three heterogeneous medical imaging tasks: Chest X-Ray pneumonia classification, Brain MRI tumor detection, and dermoscopic Skin Cancer classification. The evaluated architectures include ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet121, DeiT-Small, and Swin-Tiny. The framework integrates transfer learning, class-imbalance handling, model calibration, bootstrap confidence intervals, robustness evaluation, failure-case analysis, Grad-CAM explainability, ensemble learning , and extensive performance metrics. In addition, an LLM-driven reporting component is incorporated to generate structured model-comparison summaries, explainability interpretations, and decision-support reports. The LLM layer is constrained to provide research-oriented assistance rather than autonomous clinical diagnosis. Experimental results demonstrate that CNN architectures remain highly effective for structured radiographic images, while Vision Transformers provide strong performance and robustness for more contextually complex Brain MRI and dermoscopic imaging tasks.
items.summary_zh: 一个端到端医学影像框架，在胸部 X 光、脑 MRI 和皮肤镜图像任务中比较 CNN 与 Vision Transformer，并联合校准、鲁棒性、Grad-CAM 和 LLM 报告生成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时评估性能、校准、扰动鲁棒性和可解释性，展示了不同模型家族在不同影像结构上的互补性，但仍是 preprint，不能视为临床诊断验证。
items.abstract_zh: 医学图像分类所需的不仅是高预测准确率。一个具有实际用途的人工智能系统还必须提供可靠的置信度估计、在图像扰动下的鲁棒性、可解释的预测，以及面向下游决策支持的有意义报告。本项目提出一个端到端的比较性医学影像框架，在三类异质医学影像任务上评估卷积神经网络和 Vision Transformer：胸部 X 光肺炎分类、脑 MRI 肿瘤检测和皮肤镜皮肤癌分类。评估的架构包括 ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0、DenseNet121、DeiT-Small 和 Swin-Tiny。该框架整合了迁移学习、类别不平衡处理、模型校准、bootstrap 置信区间、鲁棒性评估、失败案例分析、Grad-CAM 可解释性、集成学习和广泛的性能指标。此外，框架还加入了 LLM 驱动的报告组件，用于生成结构化的模型比较摘要、可解释性解读和决策支持报告。LLM 层被限制为提供研究导向的辅助，而不是自主临床诊断。实验结果表明，CNN 架构对结构化的放射学图像仍然非常有效，而 Vision Transformer 在上下文更复杂的脑 MRI 和皮肤镜图像上表现出较强的性能和鲁棒性。

items.title: EpiZoo: a DNA sequence-aware foundation model for cross-species single-cell epigenomics
items.abstract_or_text: Large-scale single-cell epigenomic atlases characterize chromatin regulatory landscapes across diverse biological contexts, spanning cell types, tissues, individuals and species. Foundation models provide an opportunity to capture the full spectrum of cellular diversity in these atlases, yet current models remain largely confined to individual species by genomic coordinate dependence and overlook regulatory information encoded in DNA sequences. Here we introduce EpiZoo, a DNA sequence-aware foundation model for cross-species single-cell epigenomics. EpiZoo converts million-dimensional single-cell epigenomic profiles from diverse species into compact cell sentences that integrate DNA-encoded regulatory information, sequence-independent epigenomic context and accessibility-based importance. Built around a mixture-of-experts transformer and containing 2.6 billion parameters in total, EpiZoo is pretrained on our manually curated multi-species Omni-scATAC corpus of approximately 20.9 million cells to learn regulatory programs across species. On external datasets excluded from pretraining, EpiZoo achieves state-of-the-art performance in fundamental single-cell analysis tasks, including feature extraction, cell type annotation and data imputation. Its sequence-aware architecture enables extension to evolutionarily diverse species, and supports comparative analysis of regulatory conservation and divergence during primate evolution. Benefiting from this modeling design, EpiZoo enables context-aware prioritization of somatic mutations in cancer and prediction of cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility from DNA sequences across genomic regions and species.
items.summary_zh: EpiZoo 是一个面向跨物种单细胞表观基因组学、结合 DNA 序列信息的 foundation model，在约 20.9 million cells 上预训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 2.6 billion 参数和跨物种外部数据评估使其具有较大规模；结果支持调控保守性、分化和癌症体细胞突变优先级研究，但仍需独立复现。
items.abstract_zh: 大规模单细胞表观基因组图谱刻画了跨越细胞类型、组织、个体和物种的多种生物学背景下的染色质调控景观。Foundation model 提供了捕获这些图谱中完整细胞多样性的机会，但现有模型大多由于依赖基因组坐标而局限于单一物种，并忽略了 DNA 序列中编码的调控信息。我们在此介绍 EpiZoo，一个面向跨物种单细胞表观基因组学、能够感知 DNA 序列的 foundation model。EpiZoo 将来自不同物种的 million-dimensional 单细胞表观基因组谱转换为紧凑的 cell sentences，整合 DNA 编码的调控信息、与序列无关的表观基因组背景以及基于可及性的权重。EpiZoo 以 mixture-of-experts transformer 为核心，总参数量为 2.6 billion，在我们人工整理的多物种 Omni-scATAC corpus（约 20.9 million cells）上进行预训练，以学习跨物种的调控程序。在排除于预训练之外的外部数据集上，EpiZoo 在特征提取、细胞类型注释和数据插补等基础单细胞分析任务中取得了 state-of-the-art 性能。其序列感知架构可以扩展到进化上多样的物种，并支持比较灵长类进化过程中的调控保守性与分化。得益于这种建模设计，EpiZoo 可以对癌症中的体细胞突变进行背景感知的优先级排序，并从跨基因组区域和物种的 DNA 序列预测细胞类型特异性的染色质可及性。
items.author_line: Li, K., Chen, X., Jiang, Q., Wang, Z., Lv, H., Jiang, R.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for MRI-Based Identification of Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Systematic Review of Methods, Performance, and Clinical Translation
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by impairments in social communication and restricted or repetitive behaviours. Early diagnosis is important for timely intervention, motivating increasing interest in computer-aided diagnostic systems based on neuroimaging data. Objective This review aims to systematically review MRI-based machine learning and deep learning studies that classified individuals with ASD and controls and to evaluate current dataset, preprocessing methods, modelling approaches, validation strategies, and barriers to clinical translation. Methods A systematic literature review was conducted following the PRISMA guidelines. Studies published between 2015 and 2026 were retrieved from Scopus, Web of Science, and PubMed databases. After applying predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, 86 journal articles were selected for detailed analysis. Results The reviewed studies were categorized according to the imaging modality employed, including structural MRI (sMRI), functional MRI (fMRI), and multimodal approaches. The analysis covered datasets, preprocessing pipelines, feature engineering techniques, brain atlases, and classification models. fMRI was the most frequently used modality, while graph neural networks, transformers, and multimodal fusion frameworks emerged as the dominant methodological trends. Despite encouraging results, challenges related to dataset heterogeneity, limited sample size, model interpretability, and clinical generalizability remain. Conclusions MRI-based machine learning and deep learning methods show considerable potential for ASD diagnosis. Future research should focus on multimodal integration, explainable AI, and large-scale harmonized datasets to support clinically reliable diagnostic systems.
items.summary_zh: 按 PRISMA 系统综述 2015—2026 年 86 篇 MRI 结合机器学习或深度学习识别 Autism Spectrum Disorder 的研究，并评估数据集、验证和临床转化障碍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为 MRI-LLM/深度学习临床转化提供了较完整的方法学地图，同时明确指出异质性、小样本、可解释性和泛化问题；该项目本身为 preprint。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：Autism Spectrum Disorder（ASD）是一种神经发育状况，其特征是社会沟通受损以及受限或重复性行为。早期诊断对于及时干预十分重要，这推动了基于神经影像数据的计算机辅助诊断系统不断发展。目的：本综述旨在系统评估利用 MRI 的机器学习和深度学习研究，这些研究对 ASD 个体与对照者进行分类，并评价当前的数据集、预处理方法、建模方法、验证策略和临床转化障碍。方法：按照 PRISMA 指南开展系统性文献综述。从 Scopus、Web of Science 和 PubMed 数据库检索 2015 至 2026 年发表的研究。在应用预先规定的纳入和排除标准后，选取 86 篇期刊文章进行详细分析。结果：根据所使用的影像模态对纳入研究进行分类，包括结构 MRI（sMRI）、功能 MRI（fMRI）和多模态方法。分析覆盖数据集、预处理流程、特征工程技术、脑图谱和分类模型。fMRI 是最常使用的模态，而图神经网络、transformer 和多模态融合框架成为主要的方法学趋势。尽管结果令人鼓舞，但数据集异质性、样本量有限、模型可解释性和临床泛化能力等挑战仍然存在。结论：基于 MRI 的机器学习和深度学习方法显示出用于 ASD 诊断的较大潜力。未来研究应聚焦于多模态整合、可解释 AI 和大规模协调一致的数据集，以支持临床上可靠的诊断系统。
items.author_line: Nayak S, Gudigar A, U R, Yeong CH, Inamdar MA, Hegde A, Salvi M

items.title: TxCyto: A machine learning framework for estimating cytokine activity from whole transcriptome
items.abstract_or_text: Cytokines are critical mediators of intercellular communication, and a comprehensive characterization of their activity is essential for understanding health and disease. Existing tools to infer cytokine activity rely on experimental measurements. However, such measurements are available only for a small minority (43) of cytokines, and moreover, cytokine activity and response are highly context-specific, making a comprehensive experimental profiling across tissues, disease states, and biological contexts impractical. To address this gap, we developed TxCyto - a deep learning-based framework that infers the activity of cytokines, and more broadly of the tumor secretome, directly from the whole transcriptome profile of a sample. Trained on pan-cancer TCGA tumor transcriptomes, TxCyto was extensively validated in multiple independent datasets, including cytokine perturbation experiments. Across multiple cancer immunotherapy cohorts, TxCyto identified cytokines whose predicted activity was associated with therapeutic response. Furthermore, in spatial transcriptomic data for Liver cancer, TxCyto discovered spatial niches associated with response to immunotherapy. Overall, we develop a machine learning tool -TxCyto, for predicting the activity of 645 cytokines and tumor secretome from readily available whole transcriptomes. The TxCyto framework is generally applicable to other classes of regulatory molecules and TxCyto code base, and the tools are provided at https://github.com/Rahulncbs/TxCyto.
items.summary_zh: TxCyto 从 whole transcriptome 推断 645 种 cytokines 及 tumor secretome 活性，并在多种独立数据集、扰动实验和癌症免疫治疗队列中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把难以全面实验测量的 cytokine activity 转化为可从转录组估计的信号，并与治疗反应和空间免疫治疗生态位相关联；这些关联不等于因果作用。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞因子是细胞间通信的重要介质，全面表征其活性对于理解健康和疾病至关重要。现有用于推断细胞因子活性的工具依赖实验测量。然而，只有少数细胞因子（43 种）具有这类测量，而且细胞因子活性和反应高度依赖具体背景，因此不可能在组织、疾病状态和生物学背景的广泛范围内进行全面实验分析。为解决这一空缺，我们开发了 TxCyto——一个基于深度学习的框架，可直接从样本的 whole transcriptome profile 推断细胞因子活性，并进一步推断 tumor secretome 活性。TxCyto 在 pan-cancer TCGA tumor transcriptomes 上训练，并在多个独立数据集中进行了广泛验证，其中包括细胞因子扰动实验。在多个癌症免疫治疗队列中，TxCyto 识别出其预测活性与治疗反应相关的细胞因子。此外，在 Liver cancer 的空间转录组数据中，TxCyto 发现了与免疫治疗反应相关的空间生态位。总体而言，我们开发了机器学习工具 TxCyto，可从容易获得的 whole transcriptomes 预测 645 种细胞因子和 tumor secretome 的活性。TxCyto 框架通常也适用于其他调控分子类别，TxCyto code base 和工具已在 https://github.com/Rahulncbs/TxCyto 提供。
items.author_line: Kumar, R., Li, S., Jiang, P., Hannenhalli, S.

items.title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. FOCUS provides a practical framework and public benchmark to assess generalization, reliability, and robustness beyond single-dataset leaderboards
items.summary_zh: FOCUS 在 10 个公开数据集上统一评估视网膜 foundation vision encoders、VLM 和 MLLM，覆盖 532 个基础配置和 228 个 MLLM 配置。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把跨数据集泛化、校准、亚组差异和图像质量鲁棒性纳入同一基准，显示单一 leaderboard 不能代表临床可靠性；为 preprint benchmark。
items.abstract_zh: AI 驱动的视网膜图像分析不断进步，但评估其可靠性仍然具有挑战。在单一数据集上报告的性能无法反映模型在数据集偏移、不同临床定义或不同患者亚组下的表现。这一局限对于医学影像分析尤其关键，因为鲁棒性、校准和公平性是安全部署的必要条件。我们提出 FOCUS（Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift），一个用于评估视网膜眼底模型的跨数据集基准，涵盖仅视觉编码器模型（VM）、视觉-语言双编码器模型（VLM）和多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。FOCUS 在 10 个公开数据集上统一了糖尿病视网膜病变、可转诊糖尿病视网膜病变和青光眼性视神经病变三类任务；这些数据集具有不同的地理来源、采集条件和标签协议。该基准通过统一分析层评估排序性能、校准、亚组差异和图像质量鲁棒性。我们开展了大规模评估，覆盖 532 个基础配置和 228 个通过 supervised fine-tuning 与 low-rank adaptation（LoRA）适配的 MLLM 配置。结果显示，没有任何模型家族在所有任务和数据集上持续占优：通用 VM encoder 的平均排序性能最强，医学 MLLM 具有竞争力但表现多变，而双编码器 VLM 从轻量级适配中获益显著。Fine-tuning 能提高域内性能，但向外部数据集迁移时表现不一致，尤其是在校准方面。这些发现表明，视网膜模型评估本质上是多维的。FOCUS 提供了一个实用的公开基准，用于超越单一数据集 leaderboard，评估泛化、可靠性和鲁棒性。
items.author_line: David Restrepo, Chenwei Wu, Luis Filipe Nakayama, Miguel L. Martins, Stergios Christodoulidis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Enzo Ferrante

items.title: DECIPHER integrates disentangled representation learning and prototype-based cell-type deconvolution across molecular modalities
items.abstract_or_text: The growing availability of single-cell resources creates new opportunities to extract cell-type-resolved information from the vast body of existing bulk omics data through cell-type deconvolution. Conventional deconvolution methods often rely on linear mixture models or specific probabilistic assumptions and can be sensitive to batch effects, whereas many deep-learning approaches are modality-specific or lack a unified end-to-end learning framework. Here, we developed DECIPHER, an end-to-end representation-learning framework for cell-type deconvolution that can be applied across multiple molecular modalities. DECIPHER learns a domain-constant representation (Zc) for deconvolution and a domain-specific representation (Zs) to model domain-associated variation. By integrating nonlinear representation learning with differentiable non-negative least-squares optimization, DECIPHER estimates cell-type proportions from Zc. Across simulated datasets, experimentally generated bulk-cell mixtures, real-world datasets, and multiple molecular modalities, DECIPHER showed robust and competitive cell-type deconvolution performance. Beyond cell-type proportion estimation, the learned Zc supported chronological age prediction across independent cohorts and prognostic stratification in lung adenocarcinoma, demonstrating that DECIPHER can transform high-dimensional bulk omics data into low-dimensional, biologically informative representations. DECIPHER thus broadens the utility of existing bulk omics resources for biological discovery and clinical research.
items.summary_zh: DECIPHER 用 domain-constant 与 domain-specific 表征结合可微 non-negative least-squares，在多种分子模态和多类数据集上进行 cell-type deconvolution。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将 bulk omics 转换为细胞类型比例和低维生物学表征，并在独立队列中支持年龄预测和肺腺癌预后分层；预后用途仍需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞资源不断增加，为从大量既有 bulk omics 数据中提取细胞类型分辨信息创造了新机会，这可以通过 cell-type deconvolution 实现。传统 deconvolution 方法通常依赖线性混合模型或特定的概率假设，并且可能对批次效应敏感；许多深度学习方法则具有模态特异性，或缺少统一的端到端学习框架。在此，我们开发了 DECIPHER，一个可应用于多种分子模态的端到端表征学习框架，用于 cell-type deconvolution。DECIPHER 学习一个用于 deconvolution 的 domain-constant representation（Zc）和一个用于建模领域相关变异的 domain-specific representation（Zs）。通过将非线性表征学习与可微的 non-negative least-squares 优化结合，DECIPHER 从 Zc 估计细胞类型比例。在模拟数据集、实验生成的 bulk-cell mixtures、真实世界数据集以及多种分子模态上，DECIPHER 都显示出稳健且具有竞争力的 cell-type deconvolution 性能。除了估计细胞类型比例之外，所学习的 Zc 还支持在独立队列中预测生理年龄，并对 lung adenocarcinoma 进行预后分层，表明 DECIPHER 可以将高维 bulk omics 数据转换为低维且具有生物学信息的表征。因此，DECIPHER 扩展了既有 bulk omics 资源在生物学发现和临床研究中的用途。
items.author_line: Lai, W., Li, C., Deng, Q., Zhu, Y., Liu, C., Li, Z., Luo, O. J.

items.title: Analyzing Genomic Foundation Models for Viral Sequence Identification
items.abstract_or_text: Rapid and accurate identification of viral sequences underpins clinical diagnostics, epidemiological surveillance, and the safety testing of biological products, yet the established alignment-based methods such as BLAST are inherently closed-set, with accuracy tied to how well a query is already represented in the reference database. Recent advances in genomic foundation models (GFMs) have enabled alignment-free approaches to sequence classification. However, their performance relative to traditional methods remains incompletely characterised. We evaluated GFMs, specifically the Nucleotide Transformer (NT) and DNABERT families, for viral sequence classification using a dataset derived from the Reference Viral Database (RVDB). Sequence embeddings were generated with mean, max, and CLS pooling, classified by nearest-neighbour search in an embedding index and compared with BLAST as a reference. Matching BLAST provided a particularly stringent benchmark here, because as a closed-set method it compares each query directly against the exact reference sequences it stores, whereas a foundation model must rely on representations shaped by broad, general-purpose pre-training. On sequences of standard length, the best model, NTv3-650M, reached an accuracy of 0.93, approaching the 0.97 achieved by BLAST. On long genomic sequences, evaluated on a much smaller test set, the difference narrowed further, with NTv3-650M reaching 0.95 against 0.98 for BLAST. Robustness analyses showed that all GFMs were markedly more sensitive to base masking than BLAST. Both methods indexed the same labelled reference sequences, and BLAST compared queries with them directly at the nucleotide level, so approaching it from frozen, general-purpose representations without any parameter update is a meaningful result. NTv3-650M emerged as the most promising candidate for further optimisation and deployment in bioinformatics applications.
items.summary_zh: 比较 Nucleotide Transformer 与 DNABERT 家族对病毒序列的无比对分类，并与 BLAST 进行严格对照；NTv3-650M 在标准长度序列上达到 0.93 accuracy。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了 foundation model 与闭集 BLAST 的直接、可解释比较，同时揭示模型对 base masking 更敏感；长序列测试集较小，结论仍需外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 快速且准确地识别病毒序列是临床诊断、流行病学监测和生物制品安全检测的基础。然而，BLAST 等既有的基于比对的方法本质上是闭集方法，其准确性取决于查询序列在参考数据库中的表示程度。基因组 foundation model 的近期进展推动了无比对的序列分类方法。但与传统方法相比，它们的性能仍未得到充分刻画。我们使用源自 Reference Viral Database（RVDB）的数据集，评估了基因组 foundation model，具体包括 Nucleotide Transformer（NT）和 DNABERT 家族，用于病毒序列分类。我们使用 mean、max 和 CLS pooling 生成序列嵌入，在 embedding index 中通过最近邻搜索进行分类，并以 BLAST 作为参照进行比较。在这里，与 BLAST 的匹配构成了尤其严格的基准，因为 BLAST 作为闭集方法，直接将每个查询与其存储的精确参考序列比较，而 foundation model 必须依赖由广泛通用预训练形成的表征。在标准长度序列上，最佳模型 NTv3-650M 的准确率达到 0.93，接近 BLAST 的 0.97。在长基因组序列上，测试集规模小得多，差距进一步缩小，NTv3-650M 达到 0.95，而 BLAST 为 0.98。鲁棒性分析显示，与 BLAST 相比，所有基因组 foundation model 对碱基 masking 都明显更敏感。两种方法使用了相同的带标签参考序列建立索引，而 BLAST 在核苷酸水平直接与这些序列比较，因此，未进行参数更新的通用冻结表征能够接近 BLAST，是一个有意义的结果。NTv3-650M 成为进一步优化和部署于生物信息学应用的最有希望候选者。
items.author_line: Buzkova, V., Dvorsky, B., Komarkova, M., Kollinova, K., Krupicka, R., Klempir, O.

items.title: EHRAdapt: Adapting Pretrained Language Models to Electronic Health Records with Semantic Priors for Rare Clinical Events
items.abstract_or_text: Electronic health records (EHRs) encode clinical histories as (time, modality, code) tuples, whereas pretrained language models expect text tokens. Serializing them as text inflates sequence length and redundantly encodes structure. We introduce EHRAdapt, an adapter that maps tuples directly into a frozen language model's embedding space. Modality receives a learned embedding, time gaps enter through learned attention biases, and event codes receive dedicated vectors. Learning event vectors is the central challenge: clinical vocabularies are long-tailed, leaving rare events too few observations for reliable estimates. EHRAdapt therefore represents each event vector as the sum of a semantic prior and an evidence residual. The prior is a frozen embedding of the event's clinical description from a biomedical language model trained on clinical ontologies, mapped into the model's input space by a shared learned projection, so it supplies clinical meaning even when observations are scarce. The residual, a learned low-rank event-specific correction, refines it as evidence accumulates. We run continued pretraining on about 4 million patients' records with three frozen LLM backbones (OLMo2 1B, Llama3.2 1B, and OLMo2 7B), training only the adapter (0.1--0.6% of all parameters). The full adapter outperforms all ablations in held-out next-event prediction on every backbone. Removing the semantic pathway hurts rare events over ten times more than the most frequent ones, whereas removing the residual hurts overall prediction but improves it for the rarest events. On reportable infectious-disease and syndromic downstream classification tasks, EHRAdapt outperforms text-based LLM and count-based baselines, and both pathways improve rare-disease discrimination. The two pathways therefore play complementary roles, visible only when results are broken down by event frequency rather than averaged.
items.summary_zh: EHRAdapt 将时间、模态和代码元组直接映射到冻结语言模型嵌入空间，在约 4 million 患者记录上仅训练 0.1—0.6% 参数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 语义先验与证据残差共同处理临床长尾事件，在稀有事件预测和感染病/综合征分类上优于基线；结果来自 preprint，尚非临床部署证据。
items.abstract_zh: 电子健康记录（EHR）将临床病史编码为（时间、模态、代码）元组，而预训练语言模型需要文本 token。将这些元组序列化为文本会增加序列长度，并冗余地编码结构。我们提出 EHRAdapt，一个将元组直接映射到冻结语言模型嵌入空间的 adapter。模态接收一个学习得到的嵌入，时间间隔通过学习得到的 attention bias 输入，事件代码接收专用向量。学习事件向量是核心挑战：临床词汇表具有长尾分布，稀有事件的观测太少，难以获得可靠估计。因此，EHRAdapt 将每个事件向量表示为语义先验与证据残差之和。语义先验是一个 biomedical language model 对事件临床描述的冻结嵌入；该模型在临床本体上训练，并通过共享的学习投影映射到目标模型的输入空间，因此即使观测稀少，也能提供临床语义。残差是一个学习得到的低秩、事件特异性修正，用于随着证据积累进行细化。我们在约 4 million 患者的记录上进行 continued pretraining，使用三个冻结的 LLM backbone（OLMo2 1B、Llama3.2 1B 和 OLMo2 7B），仅训练 adapter，占全部参数的 0.1--0.6%。在每个 backbone 上，完整 adapter 在保留的 next-event prediction 任务中都优于所有消融版本。去除语义通路对稀有事件的影响比对最高频事件的影响大十倍以上，而去除残差会损害总体预测，却能改善最稀有事件的预测。在可报告传染病和综合征的下游分类任务中，EHRAdapt 优于基于文本的 LLM 和基于计数的基线，两条通路都改善了罕见疾病判别。因此，只有在按事件频率拆分结果、而不是取平均时，才能观察到两条通路的互补作用。
items.author_line: Andre R Goncalves, Vincent Liu, Priyadip Ray

items.title: Inferring cascade drivers of VEXAS syndrome by a causal machine learning tool CauNagi
items.abstract_or_text: VEXAS syndrome is an adult-onset severe autoinflammatory disease caused by somatic mutations in UBA1, yet the cascade mechanisms linking primitive hematopoietic abnormalities to mature myeloid dysfunctions remain largely unknown. Identifying master regulators of a progressive disease, a black-box process, from complex transcriptomic data also remains challenging. To address this challenge, we developed CauNagi, a computational framework for prioritizing cascade candidate regulators (CCRs). CauNagi integrates a causal representation learning module derived from CausCell with an iterative deep learning backbone adapted from UNAGI; in addition, CauNagi extends these two components with a unique downstream module for CCRs analysis designed to characterize regulatory propagation across hierarchical cellular states. Mechanistically, CauNagi iteratively integrates causal disentangled representation learning with (1) disease-stage cell-state trajectory reconstruction and (2) dynamic regulatory analysis. Benchmarking on single-cell transcriptomic datasets showed that CauNagi preserved cell-type structure in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and enriched known acute myeloid leukemia(AML)-associated genes among its top-ranked global regulators. When applied to VEXAS syndrome, CauNagi readily revealed inflammatory responses, endoplasmic reticulum stress, and myeloid bias, consistent with the disease features. Furthermore, the CCRs analysis module of CauNagi assisted us in identifying 36 causal drivers, with SPI1, NFKB1, STAT3, and FOS prioritized as high-confidence regulatory hubs linking aberrant myeloid differentiation and inflammatory programs. These findings were further supported by an independent single-cell transcriptomic dataset from a murine VEXAS model. Overall, CauNagi provides a computationally efficient and systematic framework for identifying candidate causal regulators. Beyond hematopoietic diseases, CauNagi may also be applicable to other progressive disorders for which multistage single-cell transcriptomic datasets are available. CauNagi is available at https://github.com/steamed-stuffed-bun/CauNagi.
items.summary_zh: CauNagi 将 causal representation learning、迭代深度学习和阶段性调控传播分析结合，用于从单细胞转录组中优先筛选 VEXAS syndrome 的 cascade candidate regulators。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 VEXAS syndrome 中提出 36 个候选因果驱动因子，并由独立小鼠数据支持 SPI1、NFKB1、STAT3 和 FOS 等调控枢纽；这些仍是候选机制而非已证实因果关系。
items.abstract_zh: VEXAS syndrome 是一种成年起病的严重自身炎症性疾病，由 UBA1 的体细胞突变引起，但从原始造血异常到成熟髓系功能障碍之间的级联机制仍大体未知。从复杂转录组数据中识别进行性疾病的主调控因子这一黑箱过程，同样具有挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们开发了 CauNagi，一个用于优先筛选 cascade candidate regulators（CCRs）的计算框架。CauNagi 整合了源自 CausCell 的 causal representation learning 模块和改编自 UNAGI 的迭代深度学习骨干；此外，CauNagi 还加入了一个独特的下游 CCRs 分析模块，用于刻画层级细胞状态之间的调控传播。在机制上，CauNagi 迭代整合因果解耦表征学习与以下两类过程：（1）疾病阶段的细胞状态轨迹重建；（2）动态调控分析。在单细胞转录组数据集上的基准测试显示，CauNagi 保留了 idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis（IPF）的细胞类型结构，并在其排名靠前的全局调控因子中富集了已知的 acute myeloid leukemia（AML）相关基因。当应用于 VEXAS syndrome 时，CauNagi 识别出与疾病特征一致的炎症反应、内质网应激和髓系偏向。此外，CCRs 分析模块帮助我们识别出 36 个因果驱动因子，其中 SPI1、NFKB1、STAT3 和 FOS 被优先列为高置信度调控枢纽，连接异常髓系分化与炎症程序。这些发现还得到独立 VEXAS 小鼠模型单细胞转录组数据集的支持。总体而言，CauNagi 提供了一个计算高效且系统的方法，用于识别候选因果调控因子。除造血系统疾病外，对于具有多阶段单细胞转录组数据的其他进行性疾病，CauNagi 也可能适用。CauNagi 可在 https://github.com/steamed-stuffed-bun/CauNagi 获取。
items.author_line: Bao, D., Yao, H., Liu, J., Dong, G., Xu, S., Cai, Z.

items.title: NexuST: A Hierarchical Foundation Model for Spatial Transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics captures molecular states within cells and their organisation in tissue. However, integrating fine-grained gene information with spatial context at scale remains challenging for existing foundation models. Here we present NexuST, a hierarchical foundation model that repeatedly interleaves gene-level molecular modelling with cell-level spatial modelling, allowing the two levels to refine one another during end-to-end pretraining. For pretraining, we curated HumanST-46M, comprising 45.7 million human cells from 72 datasets across 11 organs and three imaging-based platforms. Across four held-out datasets totalling approximately 2.6 million cells, NexuST achieved state-of-the-art or competitive performance in cell-type annotation, region prediction, gene recovery and neighbourhood-composition prediction. We find that cell-intrinsic expression remains informative even for spatial tasks, as shown by an expression-only PCA baseline, while NexuST shows particularly strong gains where spatial context is essential. Overall, NexuST establishes a hierarchical framework that can serve as a general backbone for future spatial transcriptomics foundation models.
items.summary_zh: NexuST 以分层架构交替建模基因层分子信息和细胞层空间信息，在 HumanST-46M 的 45.7 million human cells 上预训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨 72 个数据集、11 个器官和 3 个成像平台，并在约 2.6 million held-out cells 上评估，适合作为空间转录组 backbone；部分任务仍接近表达量基线。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学捕获细胞内的分子状态及其在组织中的组织方式。然而，对于现有 foundation model 而言，在大规模条件下整合精细的基因信息与空间背景仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 NexuST，一个分层 foundation model，通过反复交替进行基因层分子建模与细胞层空间建模，使两个层级在端到端预训练期间相互改进。为进行预训练，我们整理了 HumanST-46M，其中包含来自 72 个数据集、11 个器官和 3 个基于成像的平台的 45.7 million human cells。在总计约 2.6 million cells 的四个留出数据集上，NexuST 在细胞类型注释、区域预测、基因恢复和邻域组成预测方面取得了 state-of-the-art 或具有竞争力的性能。我们发现，即使对于空间任务，细胞内在表达仍然具有信息量，这一点由仅使用表达的 PCA baseline 所显示；而在空间背景不可或缺的场景中，NexuST 的提升尤其明显。总体而言，NexuST 建立了一个分层框架，可作为未来空间转录组 foundation model 的通用 backbone。
items.author_line: Liu, H., Zhao, Q., Lin, L., Zou, Z., Cai, W., Sun, J., Zhou, Y., Alvarez, M. A., Gilmore, A., Rattray, M., Frangi, A. F., Zhou, H.

items.title: A new bioorthogonal PET reporter gene for cardiac regenerative medicine binding to DTPA-lanthanide complexes
items.abstract_or_text: The lack of non-invasive, quantitative methods to track the location and proliferation of transplanted cells hampers the clinical translation of cardiac regenerative therapies. Here, we establish a PET reporter for tracking human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived cardiac cells across complementary two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) cardiac tissue models. Methods hiPSCs were genetically engineered using CRISPR-Cas9 to express a human-derived, anticalin-based, bioorthogonal PET reporter (DTPA-R) that specifically binds radiolabeled DTPA-metal complexes. The engineered hiPSCs were differentiated into ventricular progenitors (HVPs) and cardiomyocytes (CMs). Stability of reporter gene expression and its effects on cellular differentiation and function were evaluated. Uptake of [18F]F-DTPA*Tb by DTPA-R-positive and -negative HVPs was analyzed in vitro, and DTPA-R HVPs were evaluated in ex vivo cultured porcine myocardial slices with and without radiofrequency ablation (RFA) injury. Phantom studies were performed to evaluate PET detectability under clinically relevant large-animal and human imaging conditions and to assess how activity distribution affects signal detection in relation to DTPA-R cardiac cell-equivalent numbers. Results DTPA-R expression was maintained during the differentiation stages of hiPSC-derived cardiac cells and had no measurable impact on migration, differentiation, and functional integration. PET imaging enabled the specific detection of DTPA-R HVPs in intact and injured myocardial slices. At the initial phantom scan, the measured activity corresponded to cell-equivalent numbers of approximately 3.2 x 10^6 HVPs or 5.5 x 10^6 CMs. The compact 200 uL source remained clearly detectable at 6 h, whereas the more dispersed 1,000 uL source progressively approached background activity, indicating that PET detectability depended strongly on local activity concentration and distribution. Conclusion This study establishes a bioorthogonal PET reporter gene platform for quantitative imaging of hiPSC-derived cardiac cells, with no measurable adverse effects on the biological parameters examined, and provides a methodological foundation for future translational and in vivo imaging studies. The approach may also be applicable to other hiPSC-derived cell products beyond cardiac cell lineages.
items.summary_zh: 利用 CRISPR-Cas9 构建 DTPA-R bioorthogonal PET reporter gene，追踪 hiPSC 衍生心脏细胞在 2D、3D 和猪心肌切片中的位置。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时检验报告基因对分化和功能的影响，并量化 PET 对约 3.2 x 10^6 HVPs 或 5.5 x 10^6 CMs 的检测能力，为细胞治疗追踪提供转化基础。
items.abstract_zh: 缺乏非侵入性、定量追踪移植细胞位置和增殖的方法，阻碍了心脏再生治疗的临床转化。在此，我们建立了一个 PET reporter，用于在互补的二维（2D）和三维（3D）心脏组织模型中追踪人 induced pluripotent stem cell（hiPSC）衍生的心脏细胞。方法：使用 CRISPR-Cas9 对 hiPSC 进行基因工程改造，使其表达一种源自人、基于 anticalin 的 bioorthogonal PET reporter（DTPA-R），该 reporter 可特异性结合放射性标记的 DTPA-metal complexes。将工程化 hiPSC 分化为 ventricular progenitors（HVPs）和 cardiomyocytes（CMs）。评估 reporter gene 表达的稳定性以及其对细胞分化和功能的影响。在体外分析 DTPA-R 阳性和阴性 HVPs 对 [18F]F-DTPA*Tb 的摄取，并在有或没有 radiofrequency ablation（RFA）损伤的离体培养猪心肌切片中评估 DTPA-R HVPs。开展 phantom 研究，以评估在具有临床相关性的大动物和人体成像条件下 PET 的可检测性，并评估活度分布如何影响信号检测，以及其与 DTPA-R 心脏细胞当量数之间的关系。结果：在 hiPSC 衍生心脏细胞的分化阶段，DTPA-R 表达保持稳定，且对迁移、分化和功能整合没有可测量的影响。PET 成像能够在完整和受损的心肌切片中特异性检测 DTPA-R HVPs。在初始 phantom 扫描中，测得的活度对应于约 3.2 x 10^6 HVPs 或 5.5 x 10^6 CMs 的细胞当量数。紧凑的 200 uL 放射源在 6 h 时仍清晰可检测，而更加分散的 1,000 uL 放射源逐渐接近背景活度，表明 PET 的可检测性高度依赖局部活度浓度和分布。结论：本研究建立了一个用于定量成像 hiPSC 衍生心脏细胞的 bioorthogonal PET reporter gene 平台，在所考察的生物学参数上未见可测量的不良影响，并为未来的转化研究和体内成像研究提供了方法学基础。除心脏细胞谱系外，该方法也可能适用于其他 hiPSC 衍生的细胞产品。
items.author_line: Seyfi, S., Dorn, T., Poch, C. M., Grashei, M., Baier, E., Morath, V., Fricke, V., Fritschle, K., Skerra, A., Schwaiger, M., Kupatt, C., Laugwitz, K.-L., Moretti, A., Weber, W. A.

items.title: A plasma metabolomics workflow for breast cancer detection using quantitative GC/MS and machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: Blood-based metabolomic profiling has been widely investigated for breast cancer (BC) detection; however, clinical implementation remains limited due to variability in sample handling, analytical reproducibility, and overfitting during statistical analysis. We established a plasma GC/MS metabolomics workflow for discriminating BC from healthy controls (HC) using conventional machine-learning algorithms. Plasma samples (n = 360; BC = 180, HC = 180) were collected prospectively under standardized preanalytical conditions before surgery and the initiation of systematic anticancer therapy and analyzed using a quantitative GC/MS platform with automated derivatization. Feature selection and model development were conducted using three machine-learning (ML) algorithms (Lasso logistic regression (LR), random forest classifier (RFC), and support vector machine (SVM)). A total of 45 metabolite candidate biomarkers were identified, and the optimal number of metabolite features for each algorithm was estimated by a recursive feature elimination (RFE)-based strategy. The best-performing models achieved area under the ROC curve values (AUC) of 0.910 (LR), 0.893 (RFC), and 0.843 (SVM). We selected prioritizing candidate biomarkers consistently expressed across the multi-algorithm pipeline. A bagging ensemble model improved stability (AUC = 0.911) and reduced false-positive predictions in the independent HC dataset. In addition, model stability with respect to false-positive predictions was assessed using an independent HC cohort (n = 15) that was collected at a separate institution. These results indicate that a plasma metabolomics workflow combined with conventional multi-algorithm ML, algorithm-specific feature selection, and independent assessment provides stable discrimination between BC and HC in a moderately sized cohort.
items.summary_zh: 在前瞻性收集的 360 份血浆样本上建立定量 GC/MS 代谢组流程，用 Lasso LR、RFC 和 SVM 区分 breast cancer 与健康对照。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 标准化前处理、跨算法特征选择和独立机构健康队列降低了过拟合与假阳性风险，但队列规模仍属中等，且为 preprint。
items.abstract_zh: 基于血液的代谢组谱已被广泛研究用于 breast cancer（BC）检测；然而，由于样本处理差异、分析可重复性和统计分析中的过拟合，临床实施仍然有限。我们建立了一个血浆 GC/MS 代谢组学流程，使用传统机器学习算法区分 BC 与健康对照（HC）。血浆样本（n = 360；BC = 180，HC = 180）在标准化的前分析条件下、手术和系统性抗癌治疗开始之前进行前瞻性收集，并使用带自动衍生化的定量 GC/MS 平台进行分析。特征选择和模型开发采用三种机器学习（ML）算法：Lasso logistic regression（LR）、random forest classifier（RFC）和 support vector machine（SVM）。共识别出 45 个代谢物候选生物标志物，并通过基于 recursive feature elimination（RFE）的策略估计每种算法的最佳代谢物特征数量。表现最佳的模型获得的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）分别为 LR 0.910、RFC 0.893 和 SVM 0.843。我们优先选择在多算法流程中保持一致表达的候选生物标志物。bagging ensemble model 提高了稳定性（AUC = 0.911），并减少了独立 HC 数据集中的假阳性预测。此外，还使用在另一机构收集的独立 HC 队列（n = 15）评估模型针对假阳性预测的稳定性。这些结果表明，血浆代谢组学流程结合传统多算法 ML、算法特异性的特征选择和独立评估，可以在中等规模队列中稳定地区分 BC 与 HC。
items.author_line: Ojima, N., Yokoyama, T., Nishiumi, S., Kikuchi, S., Yoneda, K., Kimura, M., Tanaka, K., Morimoto, M., Miyazaki, A., Tomita, T., Ohyanagi, M., Nagahashi, M., Miyoshi, Y., Ikeda, M.

items.title: Examining the Clinical Utility of Deep Learning Models for Perivascular Space Segmentation in Alzheimer's Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Open-source deep learning models promise scalable quantification of MRI-visible perivascular spaces (PVS), an emerging marker of glymphatic dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Whether these models remain valid when applied to heterogeneous AD cohorts and preserve ground-truth derived biological associations has not been established. We benchmarked five open-source nnU-Net-based PVS segmentation models (nnU-Net T1, nnU-Net T1+FLAIR, mcPVS-Net, MedNet-PVS, ADNI-PVS-Net) against manual labels in 60 multi-site ADNI-3 participants balanced across cognitively unimpaired, mild cognitive impairment, and AD dementia, and in 12 publicly available scans from the VAscular Lesions object-level and segmentatiOn (VALDO) challenge. We evaluated overall, voxel, object, and lesion-wise Dice; stratified performance by region, diagnosis, scanner, PVS severity, and white matter hyperintensity (WMH) burden; and tested whether model-derived PVS burden reproduced ground-truth derived associations with AD-related biomarkers. Despite high internal performance, all models showed a specialist-generalist trade-off: the AD-trained ADNI-PVS-Net achieved highest internal performance (overall Dice = 0.58 {+/-} 0.14) but degraded most externally (Dice [≤] 0.11), while MedNet-PVS and mcPVS-Net generalized externally (Dice 0.27-0.30) but systematically misestimated PVS burden. Models were relatively robust across scanner and diagnosis but inconsistent across PVS severity, and some misclassified up to 32% of WMH as PVS. Notably, only AD-trained models reproduced the expected PVS-amyloid biomarker relationship; other models returned a null result, despite comparable or superior Dice scores. These findings show that internal segmentation accuracy and external generalizability alone do not guarantee downstream inferential validity. Careful model selection and cohort-specific validation against manual labels should precede clinical inference in AD.
items.summary_zh: 在多站点 ADNI-3 和 VALDO 扫描中比较五个开源 nnU-Net PVS 分割模型，检验内部/外部泛化及其能否重现 AD 生物标志物关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 显示 Dice 分数、外部泛化和下游生物学推断可能不一致，强调临床使用前必须进行队列特异性人工标注验证；项目为 medRxiv preprint。
items.abstract_zh: 开源深度学习模型有望对 MRI 可见的血管周围间隙（PVS）进行可扩展定量；PVS 是 Alzheimer’s disease（AD）中 glymphatic dysfunction 的新兴标志物。然而，这些模型应用于异质 AD 队列时是否仍然有效，以及能否保持源自 ground truth 的生物学关联，尚未得到确定。我们在 60 名多站点 ADNI-3 参与者上，将五个基于 nnU-Net 的开源 PVS 分割模型（nnU-Net T1、nnU-Net T1+FLAIR、mcPVS-Net、MedNet-PVS、ADNI-PVS-Net）与人工标签进行比较；这些参与者在认知未受损、轻度认知障碍和 AD 痴呆三组之间保持平衡。我们还使用了 VAscular Lesions object-level and segmentatiOn（VALDO）挑战赛公开提供的 12 份扫描。我们评估总体、体素、对象和病灶层面的 Dice；按区域、诊断、扫描仪、PVS 严重程度和白质高信号（WMH）负荷进行分层；并检验模型得到的 PVS 负荷能否重现源自 ground truth 的 AD 相关生物标志物关联。尽管内部性能较高，所有模型都表现出 specialist-generalist 权衡：AD 训练的 ADNI-PVS-Net 获得了最高的内部性能（总体 Dice = 0.58 {+/-} 0.14），但在外部数据上退化最为明显（Dice [≤] 0.11）；MedNet-PVS 和 mcPVS-Net 在外部具有更好的泛化能力（Dice 0.27-0.30），却系统性地错误估计了 PVS 负荷。模型在不同扫描仪和诊断类别之间相对稳健，但在不同 PVS 严重程度下表现不一致；有些模型将最多 32% 的 WMH 错分为 PVS。值得注意的是，只有 AD 训练模型重现了预期的 PVS-amyloid 生物标志物关系；尽管其他模型具有相当或更高的 Dice 分数，它们却得到无关联结果。这些发现表明，内部分割准确率和外部泛化能力本身并不能保证下游推断有效。在 AD 中进行临床推断前，应谨慎选择模型，并针对具体队列使用人工标签进行验证。
items.author_line: Tang, S., Younes, K., Penukonda, E., Hausle, I., Thropp, P., Lupo, J. M., Tosun, D.

items.title: PGG Enhances Olaparib Efficacy via cGAS-STING Signaling and Sensitizes Triple-Negative Breast Cancer to PD- L1 Blockade
items.abstract_or_text: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is a highly aggressive malignancy and options for targeted therapy are limited. Although PARP inhibitors (PARPi) like olaparib (Ola) leverage synthetic lethality, their clinical utility is severely impeded by drug resistance and low frequency of BRCA mutations. In this study, 1,2,3,4,6-penta-O-galloyl-{beta}-D-glucose (PGG), a natural polyphenolic compound, can induce a state of homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) in TNBC cells by inhibiting the PALB2-BRCA2 interaction. PGG potentiated the inhibitory effects of Ola on the in vitro proliferation, clonogenic potential, migration, and invasion of TNBC cells. Mechanistically, the dual therapy triggered severe oxidative stress and mitochondrial collapse, which accelerated the classical apoptosis cascade and promoted the emission of immunogenic cell death (ICD)-associated DAMPs. The accumulated cytosolic double-stranded DNA activated the innate immune cGAS-STING pathway, thereby promoting robust intra-tumoral infiltration of CD8+ T cells. Furthermore, since cGAS-STING hyperactivation drives compensatory PD-L1 upregulation on TNBC cells, incorporating anti-PD-L1 antibody into the combination regimen further reversed the immunosuppressive barrier, achieving near-complete tumor eradication and maximum infiltration of cytotoxic T cells in vivo. Bioinformatics analyses further suggested a potential network of PGG targets associated with extracellular matrix organization, offering a bioinformatics-derived hypothesis for its theoretical involvement in modulating stromal tension and vascular homeostasis. Collectively, this study establishes PGG as a multi-functional therapeutic agent integrating intracellular synthetic lethality and innate immune sensing, while providing a preliminary bioinformatic rationale for prospective microenvironmental investigation. This study also shows PGG as a multi-functional therapeutic agent that integrates intracellular synthetic lethality, innate immune sensing, and microenvironmental remodeling to convert immunologically "cold" TNBC into "hot" tumors.
items.summary_zh: PGG 通过抑制 PALB2-BRCA2 interaction 在 TNBC 细胞中诱导 HRD，增强 Olaparib，并通过 cGAS-STING 与 anti-PD-L1 在体内促进免疫清除。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 连接 DNA 修复、免疫原性细胞死亡和免疫检查点阻断，给出从体外到体内的机制链条；结果仍为 preclinical preprint，不能外推为临床疗效。
items.abstract_zh: Triple-negative breast cancer（TNBC）是一种高度侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，靶向治疗选择有限。尽管 PARP inhibitors（PARPi）如 olaparib（Ola）利用 synthetic lethality，其临床效用却受到药物耐药和 BRCA mutations 低频的严重限制。在本研究中，1,2,3,4,6-penta-O-galloyl-{beta}-D-glucose（PGG）这一天然多酚化合物能够通过抑制 PALB2-BRCA2 interaction，在 TNBC 细胞中诱导 homologous recombination deficiency（HRD）状态。PGG 增强了 Ola 对 TNBC 细胞体外增殖、克隆形成能力、迁移和侵袭的抑制作用。在机制上，双重治疗引发严重的氧化应激和线粒体崩溃，加速经典凋亡级联，并促进免疫原性细胞死亡（ICD）相关 DAMPs 的释放。积累的胞质双链 DNA 激活先天免疫 cGAS-STING 通路，从而促进 CD8+ T 细胞大量浸润肿瘤内部。此外，由于 cGAS-STING 过度激活会驱动 TNBC 细胞代偿性上调 PD-L1，将 anti-PD-L1 antibody 加入联合方案后进一步逆转免疫抑制屏障，在体内实现近乎完全的肿瘤清除以及细胞毒性 T 细胞的最大程度浸润。生物信息学分析还提示，PGG 靶点可能形成与细胞外基质组织相关的网络，为其理论上调节基质张力和血管稳态提供了源自生物信息学的假设。总体而言，本研究将 PGG 作为一种整合细胞内 synthetic lethality 与先天免疫感知的多功能治疗剂，同时为未来研究其微环境作用提供初步的生物信息学依据。本研究还表明，PGG 作为多功能治疗剂，能够整合细胞内 synthetic lethality、先天免疫感知和微环境重塑，将免疫学上的冷 TNBC 转化为热肿瘤。
